detail.longDescription: Speed Dial Hub for Firefox: quick access + tools on every new tab Bookmarks grid, search bar, sticky notes, inline calculator — all on one new tab page. Customizable layout. Built it because I wanted one tab that did 4 things instead of 4 tabs. https:// addons.mozilla.org/firefox/add on/speed-dial-hub/ # Firefox # BrowserExtension # Productivity # NewTab
